decisive_items: complex cystic mass in the pancreatic head
enhancing septa, millimetric nodules, and soft-tissue components
cystic lesion in the uncinate process
response.rationale: IPMN is favored due to location in the pancreatic head/uncinate process with complex cystic features (septa, nodules, calcifications) in an asymptomatic patient. MCN is less typical for this location and usually lacks ductal communication. Serous cystadenoma typically has microcysts and central scar, not enhancing nodules. Pancreatic cancer is usually solid, not predominantly cystic.

rejected.why: Pancreatic cancer typically presents as a solid mass; the lesion is predominantly cystic with no metastasis or lymphadenopathy, making this less likely.
Serous cystadenoma usually has microcystic architecture and central scar, not enhancing septa and mural nodules as described.
